notes.title: Red Death: 8Feet - 2019.8.13 Update released
notes.content:
1. Physical Optimization
Physical calculations were optimized. This update will help you play more accurately and pleasantly.

2. ESC menu's End of Game button has been replaced by the Restart button.

3. bullet penetration added
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/gfYc1mSclpJTTCHLup/giphy.gif[/img]
I've received a lot of feedback. Many of them said that SMG's use was higher than other firearms. So I decided to give the bullet a penetrating force.
Rifle has the highest damage and penetrating force. Thin walls or trees can be drilled easily penetrated. It'll be useful in clusters of incoming infections, or in woody terrain.

[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/cLw629uQ8zi3xYxHsJ/giphy.gif[/img]
SMG has the lowest damage, but it has powerful fire speed. They also have penetration, but they're not high enough to penetrate walls or trees.

Video:
https://youtu.be/s_3mLMmUFQI

notes.title: Red Death: 8Feet - 2019.8.11 Update released
notes.content:
[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/RiVijz1Rekbabgq5ln/giphy.gif[/img]
1. Scripts optimization
This time I learned about Singleton pattern. The technique was applied to this game, and it worked quite well.


[img]https://media.giphy.com/media/Svo2RMjqHmPRCMOVNu/giphy.gif[/img]
2. Epic dynamite play
If you've been subscribing to my YouTube channel. You know the Dynamite was originally a grenade. And you also know that if you hit a grenade with a bullet, it will explode. However, it was a feature that had been temporarily out-of-date due to some bugs before its release. But now, if your dynamite is on fire, it's possible to shoot and explode with a bullet!! (like Ashe in Overwatch)
don't worry. It won't hard because I've grown the size of the collider.
and when the dynamite explodes, if there's another dynamite around, it's going to explode in a chain.

Video: https://youtu.be/PxdS8qcLpAo

notes.title: Red Death: 8Feet - 2019.8.10 Hotfix released
notes.content:
1. a problem in no difference when shooting between aim and non-aim.
: This is not the result I intended, and I belatedly noticed it was a bug. Now, You'll be able to experience satisfying reactionary control when you aim and shoot.

2. a problem in which the host's hair did not flutter
: This is not the result I intended either, Now her hair will be as shiny as silk.

3. Dark Ambient color
: It was set up by me to create a frightening atmosphere, but that was feel rather stuffy and not scary. Now, a little pale blue light will shine through the forest.

notes.title: Red Death: 8Feet - 2019.8.9 Update released
notes.content:
As previously announced, the host's moving speed has been adjusted to a slower.

In Red Death: 8Feet, when zombies die, they drop items. And there were hidden item boxes. But many people don't know about this. Because there was no special sign. Eventually, the player would not have seen it easily and would have just missed it.
i'm aware of this, and as a solution I've modified item boxes and items to glisten softly. With the fireflies.

And there were many opinions that it's hard to find a way. When a player fights with her, he easily forgets which way he was going. So I thought a lot about how to do this, and I decided to add a new item "compass" as a result.

I put out the urgent fire right away, but I think it's not enough. Because, the player will be wandering around the street again until he gets a compass. I have to think more about solving this problem.

and I also know that the story is poor. I will add content about this at an early date. If you haven't bought this game yet, and you value the story, I recommend watching it a little more.

notes.title: Bugs fix Update!!
notes.content: We just found a deadly bug. Players who play for the first time will receive a simple manipulation tutorial. But I found a bug that didn't show the tutorial. We learned this from feedback, and we were able to fix it quickly. Thank you.
